		icon = GFX_decision_SWI_isolate_switzerland
		cost = 0
		fire_only_once = no
		visible = {
			is_ai = no
			has_idea = imp_gc_nation
			has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_gc_expanded
		}
		available = {
			hidden_trigger = { is_ai = no has_idea = imp_gc_nation }
		}
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_EB_gc_freeze_all_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				every_country = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_member NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_frozen } }
					COLDWAR_EB_freeze = yes
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
	}
